people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, “O king, live for ever!
translations.bsb: saying to King Nebuchadnezzar, “O king, may you live forever!
translations.kjv: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.
